candidates.formal_type:
∀ (n : Nat) (x : Fin (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} n 1) → Int),
  Iff (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Etingof.An.latticeRoots n) x)
    (Exists.{1} fun i =>
      Exists.{1} fun j =>
        And (Ne.{1} i j) (Eq.{1} x (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (Pi.single.{0, 0} i 1) (Pi.single.{0, 0} j 1))))
